text: Bridget is 20 weeks pregnant!! Scan on June 3rd, finding out if it's a boy or girl. She's been really sick in the mornings tho
Andile and Hadiza got engaged in Lisbon last weekend. Wedding probably next summer. Send them a card
call w Moira - her daughter Camila flies to Seoul May 14, 13 hour flight, Moira's a wreck about it. ring her the day after to see if she landed ok
Kavya's christening for the baby is Sunday 6/8 at St Mark's, lunch at the pub afterwards. I'm doing the cake
Tariq and Aisha 10 year anniversary on the 22nd. He wants to surprise her with a weekend in Bruges, asked me not to say anything
Mehmet back from Istanbul. Says his dad's much better now. Ask him how the flight with the twins went lol
um so Thabo said Joy is due in like three weeks, around July 9th, and they still haven't picked a name. he's taking two weeks off after she arrives
Divya - nut allergy, don't forget for the engagement dinner on Friday
Deepa's sister Mia had her baby!! little girl, Asha, 7lb 2. Born Tuesday morning. Get something small for the baby, maybe the knitted bunny
aarav nervous abt the best man speech, wedding is sat 9/20. text him good luck that morning
Anders and Demi called off the wedding. She's moved back to her mum's in Leeds. Check in on Demi next week, gently
Seo-yeon off to Japan for three weeks from Oct 2nd. Kyoto then Hokkaido. She loves onsen, hiking, anything with ramen
Gemma mentioned she'd love a decent travel pillow before the Sydney trip. Christmas idea?
Dimitri Kowalski - Shira's husband. Works in aviation, something with air traffic. Their son Xavier just started at uni in Glasgow
Picked up passport photos. Renewal form needs countersigning before Aug 1. Ask Phoebe if she'll sign it

Lovely long chat with Jasmine on the phone tonight. She and Oliver are renewing their vows on April 30, on the beach in Crete where they got married, 25 years! The kids are flying out the day before and they've booked a little taverna for dinner afterwards. Jasmine's worried about Oliver's knee on the flight since the surgery in March. Must send a card before they go and maybe ring the next day to see how it all went
Giulia's pregnant again, due Feb. Hasn't told work yet so keep it quiet. Her first, Marta, is 2 now and obsessed with dinosaurs
victor got the visa!!! moving to Toronto in Nov w his partner Aidan. leaving drinks on the 14th
Jamal's mum turns 70 on 5/30, the whole family's going to Morocco for it. He fly's out the week before to sort the riad
Need to book the airport parking for the 18th and sort travel insurance.
Bridget's scan went fine, it's a boy! She's still knackered though. Drop round some soup this week
Hadiza's brother Andile is the one getting married, not Thabo. Andile's fiancée is called Kavya. Note for later
So Moira rang, Camila landed safe in Seoul, all good. She's teaching English there for a year, lives in Mapo with two flatmates
Tariq said Aisha cried when he told her about Bruges. They go June 12th, back the 15th. Ask how it was when they're back
Aisha is a huge fan of Belgian chocolate and bad reality TV. Remember that for birthday
Mehmet's wife Deepa is expecting their third! Due around March 3rd. They're thinking of moving somewhere bigger beforehand
phoned dad. nothing much, garden, weather. booking flights to see him on Nov 6

okay voice note. Thabo texted at like four am, Joy had the baby, a boy, Sipho, eight pounds something. Both doing well but Joy had a c-section so she's sore. I want to send flowers, maybe the day after they get home, not before, they'll be swamped. And ask Thabo what they need
Divya and Aarav's engagement party is off - his gran passed away last week. Funeral's Thursday. Text Aarav
Demi doing better. Started a pottery class, says it's keeping her sane. Applying for jobs in Manchester
Long-haul to Auckland with Seo-yeon booked: leave 12/19, stopover in Singapore, arrive the 21st. Jet lag the day after will be brutal
Gemma's flight to Sydney got cancelled, rebooked for Thursday. She's stressed, her brother's wedding is Saturday out there. Message her Friday to make sure she made it
Shira and Dimitri celebrating 30 years Sept 9. Xavier asked if I'd help organise a surprise dinner. Book somewhere the week before
Phoebe is godmother to Giulia's new baby. Christening May 25th, Phoebe's terrified of doing a reading
Jasmine back from Crete. Photos look amazing. Oliver's knee held up fine
Victor Barros - 'Vic' to everyone - Aidan's partner. Software, works remote. Allergic to cats
The christening was lovely. Kavya's baby screamed through the whole thing lol. Bring round the photos next week
Jamal says his mum loved Morocco. She's now on about going to Egypt next spring
dentist 3pm tmrw, then pick up the dry cleaning
Mia Sato back at work in Jan after mat leave, she's dreading it. Ask her how the first week goes
Andile's stag do is in Prague, Aug 8-10. I'm in. Need to pay Tariq the deposit by July 1st
Bridget's husband Aidan Brennan wants to throw her a baby shower, end of July sometime. He's hopeless at this stuff so offered to help

Notes from lunch w Hadiza: she's planning Andile's wedding basically single handed. Venue's a barn near Hereford, date June 6th next year. Their mum's not well so she's doing everything. Mentioned she's barely sleeping. I should take her out somewhere nice soon, no wedding talk allowed
Camila met someone in Seoul apparently, Moira's not thrilled ha
Deepa's due date moved to Feb 26. Baby shower two weeks before. Get her the bassinet off the list
Remind me to call Joy on Saturday, see how she and Sipho are getting on
Mehmet nervous about flying solo to Ankara with all three kids on 4/2. I'd offered to drive them to the airport that morning
Kavya's dog Biscuit had puppies! Six of them. She's keeping one
Gemma made it to Sydney, brother's wedding was gorgeous. She said she wants to move out there eventually
Jasmine's daughter Phoebe just got engaged to some guy called Anders. Jasmine likes him. Send congrats card to Phoebe
Talked to Divya. She's ok-ish. Aarav taking his gran's death really hard. They might push the party to spring
grocery run + new suitcase before the trip. Check bag allowance
Tariq and Aisha are back from Bruges, had a great time. He's already planning their 11th
Uncle Dimitri's knee op is Oct 28, he'll be off his feet a while after. Shira's taking him
Victor and Aidan landed in Toronto. Flat's tiny but they love it. Their dog Pepper hated the flight
Moira mentioned her and Jamal have their 40th anniversary next May 3rd, thinking of a cruise. Ring her nearer the time re ideas
Xavier's girlfriend Giulia, the Italian one, is pregnant. He's 20. Shira found out the day before me and she's still in shock

recap from Sunday dinner: Bridget's due Oct 15, hospital bag packed. Aidan's mum is flying in from Cork a week after the birth to help. Bridget says the nursery's finally done, all yellow and grey. She wants a nappy cake for the shower apparently, worth noting. I'm on cake duty again
Seo-yeon got back from Japan the 23rd, says Hokkaido was the highlight. Ask for the ramen place recs
Thabo's back at work Monday. He's dreading leaving Joy and the baby
